answer: A strong sybil defense is signed physical-sensor attestation. Each agent streams tamper-proof readings from a unique environmental probe - one battered by the gale on a ridge, another beside a walnut tree in a deep canyon. Virtual machines cannot emit authentic signed telemetry, so clone farms fail. Spinning up fake identities forces the attacker to deploy a separate physical probe per agent; cost scales linearly with clones, and any reused device betrays the whole ring. Genuine distinctness becomes the cheap path.
